title: HiItsMatt.com
tagline: A portfolio that reads itself out of GitHub
summary: This site. A Vite + React front end over a Hono API that pulls the profile, language split, contribution graph and every public repository straight from GitHub's REST and GraphQL APIs, caches them in process, and streams each project's own screenshots out of its `.portfolio` folder — so a private repo can be shown without handing a token to the browser.

media.caption: The hero runs a three.js shader gradient, lazily imported so the headline paints first.
